data.description: List of card order items in the card order batch.

hasNext.description: Indicates whether there are more items on the next page.

hasPrevious.description: Indicates whether there are more items on the previous page.

balancePlatform.description: The unique identifier of the balance platform.

card.description:
The status of the card delivery.

Possible values: **created**, **rejected**, **processing**, **produced**, **shipped**, **delivered**, **notApplicable**, **unknown**.

cardOrderItemId.description: The unique identifier of the card order item.

creationDate.description: The date and time when the event was triggered, in ISO 8601 extended format. For example, **2020-12-18T10:15:30+01:00**.

paymentInstrumentId.description: The unique identifier of the payment instrument related to the card order item.

pin.description: Contains information about the status of the PIN delivery.

shippingMethod.description: The shipping method used to deliver the card or the PIN.

status.description: The status of the PIN delivery.

trackingNumber.description: The tracking number of the PIN delivery.
